## Topics

- Grouped operations: group_by() and summarize()
- Counting and proportions: count(), n()
- Relational data & two-table joins: left_join(), inner_join(), anti_join()
- Tidy data principles and reshaping: tidyr::pivot_longer() and pivot_wider()
- Handling missing values: drop_na(), replace_na()
